title: Dexter's Lab RQ registry
description: Machine-readable hypothesis ledger for a research lab. bin/rq_compile.py is the only writer besides hand edits. Validation is optional: tools validate when the jsonschema package is importable, otherwise they warn and skip.

source_doc.description: Optional path of the program doc the hypotheses were seeded from.

rq_id.description: Compact token used in ledger row ids: R.{rq_id}.{n}.

track.description: Research track or program this hypothesis belongs to. Free string; each lab defines its own tracks.

source_hypothesis_id.description: Stable hypothesis id from the lab's program doc, e.g. TRACK-H1.

execution_class.description: offline = runs unattended on archived data; human_labeling = needs human-labeled gold data; calendar_bound = needs real-world time to elapse. Mixed classes resolve to the leading one; record the mix in notes.

plan_path.description: Path of the RQ plan markdown once scoped, else null.

prereg_sha.description: sha-256 of the plan's fenced prereg block, set by bin/rq_compile.py.

prereg_thresholds.description: Verbatim numeric thresholds for this hypothesis (ASCII-normalized: >= for the geq sign, -> for arrows).

ledger_tasks.description: R.* row ids in the task ledger that execute this hypothesis.

example.description: True on shipped example entries. Delete example entries once the lab has real ones.
